headline: Earnings and margins surge, cash ticks down
summary_short: Alcoa reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $3,966M, up 31.4% y/y, with operating income of $714M up 500.0% y/y and net income of $407M (diluted EPS $1.53) up 148.2% y/y.
summary_long: Revenue of $3,966M rose 31.4% y/y and 24.2% q/q. Gross profit of $999M rose 173.0% y/y, gross margin expanding to about 25.2% of revenue from roughly 12.1% a year ago. Operating income of $714M rose 500.0% y/y (+67.6% q/q); EBITDA of $691M rose 86.8% y/y but was roughly flat q/q (-0.7%). Net income of $407M rose 148.2% y/y (-4.2% q/q); diluted EPS of $1.53 rose 146.8% y/y (-4.4% q/q). Cash of $1,352M fell 10.7% y/y and was flat q/q. Shareholders' equity of $7,370M rose 20.1% y/y and 8.0% q/q.
